notes.md: - **ODOP (One District One Product) products of AP (DPIIT list, 5 May 2023):** Anakapalli - **Etikoppaka wooden toys**; NTR - **Kondapalli toys**; Krishna - **Machilipatnam Kalamkari**; Kakinada - **Uppada Jamdani sarees**; West Godavari - **Narsapur crochet laces**; Srikakulam - **Budithi bell and brass craft**; SPSR Nellore - **Udayagiri wooden cutlery**; Guntur - **chillies**; Alluri Sitarama Raju - **Araku coffee**; Nandyal - **Banganapalli mangoes**.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a use-based class of the Index of Industrial Production (IIP)?
new.x: The IIP has six use-based classes: primary, capital, intermediate, infrastructure/construction, consumer durables and consumer non-durables. There is no export goods class.
new.angle: U0679 notes gap: IIP has no export goods class

new.s: In the Index of Core Industries (base 2022-23), which industry has the second-highest weight after electricity?
new.x: Refinery products carry 22.57, next only to electricity (30.93); steel is third at 17.58.
new.angle: U0679 notes gap: refinery products second ICI weight

new.s: From 1 April 2025, what is the investment limit of a small enterprise?
new.x: A small enterprise may invest up to ₹25 crore with turnover up to ₹100 crore; ₹2.5 crore is the micro limit and ₹125 crore the medium limit.
new.angle: U0679 notes gap: small enterprise investment limit

new.s: Which districts of Andhra Pradesh are noted for mineral-based industries?
new.x: Prakasam and Kurnool are the State's mineral-based industry districts; Nellore is known for leather and auto parts.
new.angle: U0679 notes gap: AP mineral-based districts

new.s: Through which States does the Chennai-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor (CBIC), about 560 km long, pass?
o: Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka
Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Kerala
new.x: The 560-km CBIC runs through Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka; its AP node is Krishnapatnam (KRIS City).
new.angle: U0680 notes gap: CBIC length and States

new.s: In which district is Chirala, a town known for handloom sarees, located?
new.x: Chirala, famous for handloom sarees, is in Bapatla district.
new.angle: U0680 notes gap: Chirala -> district

new.s: In which district is the proposed A.P. Space City under the BHAVYA parks located?
new.x: A.P. Space City is proposed in Tirupati district; the Drone City is in Kurnool.
new.angle: U0680 notes gap: Space City -> Tirupati

new.s: In which district is Dharmavaram, famous for silk sarees, located?
new.x: Dharmavaram, a GI-tagged silk saree town, is in Sri Sathya Sai district.
new.angle: U0680 notes gap: Dharmavaram -> district

new.s: Which of the following is a silk cluster of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Uppada is a silk cluster along with Dharmavaram, Peddapuram and Mudireddipalli; Markapur is known for slate and Etikoppaka and Kondapalli for toys.
new.angle: U0680 notes gap: silk clusters (Uppada)

new.s: According to the Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26, how many industrial clusters does APIIC have?
new.x: APIIC has 635 clusters: 331 industrial parks and 304 estates (Survey 2025-26).
new.angle: U0680 notes gap: APIIC 635 clusters

new.s: What is the capacity of the AM/NS India steel plant proposed at Rajayyapeta, Nakkapalli?
new.x: The AM/NS India integrated steel plant at Rajayyapeta, Nakkapalli (Anakapalli) is planned at 17.8 MTPA.
new.angle: U0680 notes gap: AM/NS plant capacity

new.s: With which National Highway of the Golden Quadrilateral is the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor aligned?
new.x: VCIC runs along the east coast and is aligned with NH-16, part of the Golden Quadrilateral.
new.angle: U0680 notes gap: VCIC aligned with NH-16

new.s: What is India's rank in the world by length of road network?
new.x: India's road network of 63.45 lakh km is the second largest in the world.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: road network 2nd largest

new.s: About how long is India's total road network?
new.x: India's roads total about 63.45 lakh km; National Highways make up 1.46 lakh km of it.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: road network length

new.s: What is the approximate length of the Golden Quadrilateral?
new.x: The Golden Quadrilateral (Delhi-Mumbai-Chennai-Kolkata) is about 5,846 km long; 4,112 km is NH-44 and 34,800 km is Bharatmala.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: GQ length

new.s: Which organisation promotes the Asian Highway network?
new.x: The Asian Highway network is promoted by UNESCAP, the UN Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: Asian Highway -> UNESCAP

new.s: In which year was the Border Roads Organisation (BRO) set up?
new.x: BRO was set up in 1960; it built Mig La in Ladakh, the world's highest motorable road.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: BRO 1960

new.s: Where is the headquarters of the Northeast Frontier Railway?
new.x: Northeast Frontier Railway (1958) has its headquarters at Maligaon, Guwahati; Gorakhpur is North Eastern Railway.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: NFR -> Maligaon

new.s: Where is the headquarters of the South Western Railway?
new.x: South Western Railway, formed in 2003, has its headquarters at Hubballi.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: SWR -> Hubballi

new.s:
Arrange the following railway zones in the order of their formation:
1. South Coast Railway
2. Metro Railway, Kolkata
3. South Central Railway
4. East Central Railway
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
new.x: South Central came in 1966, East Central in 2002, Metro (17th zone) in 2010 and South Coast (18th zone) in 2026.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: zone formation order

new.s: India has the world's second-largest electrified railway network after which country?
new.x: India's electrified rail network is second only to China's.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: 2nd largest electrified network

new.s: Which is the longest railway line in the world?
new.x: The Trans-Siberian Railway of Russia, Moscow to Vladivostok, is about 9,289 km long.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: longest railway line

new.s: Which is the highest civilian airport in the world?
new.x: Daocheng Yading in China, at about 4,411 m, is the world's highest civilian airport.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: highest civilian airport

new.s: Which is India's longest transport tunnel, whose breakthrough came in April 2025?
new.x: The 14.58-km Janasu Tunnel on the Rishikesh-Karnaprayag line is India's longest transport tunnel; T-50 is the longest rail tunnel on USBRL.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: Janasu longest transport tunnel

new.s: In which country is the Laerdal Tunnel, the world's longest road tunnel?
new.x: The 24.5-km Laerdal Tunnel is in Norway.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: Laerdal -> Norway

new.s: Which National Waterways are covered by the Jalvahak scheme of 2024?
new.x: The Jalvahak cargo scheme (2024) covers NW-1, NW-2 and NW-16.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: Jalvahak NWs

new.s: With which sector is the LEADS index, released since 2018, associated?
new.x: LEADS (Logistics Ease Across Different States) ranks States on logistics and has been released since 2018.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: LEADS index -> logistics

new.s: In which district of Jammu and Kashmir is the Chenab Bridge located?
new.x: The Chenab Bridge, the world's highest railway arch bridge (359 m), is at Reasi on the USBRL.
new.angle: U0681 notes gap: Chenab Bridge -> Reasi

new.s: Vizhinjam port, India's first deep-water transshipment hub, is near which city?
new.x: Vizhinjam is near Thiruvananthapuram in Kerala and has a natural depth of 18-20 m close to the shore.
new.angle: U0682 notes gap: Vizhinjam -> Thiruvananthapuram

new.s: Which of the following lands is nearest to Great Nicobar?
new.x: Sumatra is about 1,192 km away, nearer than Sri Lanka (~1,437 km), Java and Borneo.
new.angle: U0682 notes gap: nearest land to Great Nicobar

new.s: In the LPPI 2024-25, which port led the container category?
new.x: Mundra led the container category; Paradip led dry bulk and Sikka liquid bulk.
new.angle: U0682 notes gap: LPPI container leader Mundra

new.s: Which organisation publishes the Container Port Performance Index (CPPI)?
new.x: The CPPI is a World Bank index; in CPPI 2024, 2 Indian ports were in the top 30 and 7 in the top 100.
new.angle: U0682 notes gap: CPPI -> World Bank

new.s: In which country is Maracaibo, a major oil port?
new.x: Maracaibo is an oil port of Venezuela; Alexandria is in Egypt.
new.angle: U0682 notes gap: Maracaibo -> Venezuela

new.s: Which of the following was NOT among the maritime laws enacted in 2025?
new.x: The 2025 maritime laws were the Merchant Shipping Act, Coastal Shipping Act and Indian Ports Act; the Major Port Authorities Act is an older law of 2021.
new.angle: U0682 notes gap: 2025 maritime laws

new.s: In a six-digit PIN code, what does the third digit indicate?
new.x: The first digit is the zone, the second the sub-zone, the third the sorting district and the last three the delivery office.
new.angle: U0683 notes gap: PIN third digit

new.s: What is the outlay of the Amended BharatNet programme?
new.x: The Amended BharatNet programme has an outlay of ₹1.39 lakh crore; 2.18 lakh is the number of Gram Panchayats connected.
new.angle: U0683 notes gap: Amended BharatNet outlay

new.s: In which district is the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram located?
new.x: Bhogapuram is in Vizianagaram district, about 50 km from Visakhapatnam.
new.angle: U0684 notes gap: Bhogapuram -> Vizianagaram

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Bhogapuram airport:
1. It is in Vizianagaram district.
2. It is Andhra Pradesh's first greenfield airport since 2014.
3. Its nodal SPV, APADCL, is a joint venture of the State and GMR.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Bhogapuram is in Vizianagaram and is AP's first greenfield airport since 2014; APADCL is 100% State-owned, while GMR is only the PPP developer.
new.angle: U0684 notes gap: Bhogapuram district and first greenfield

new.s: Which port of India is called the 'Brightest Jewel'?
new.x: Visakhapatnam port, protected by Dolphin's Nose, is called the 'Brightest Jewel'.
new.angle: U0684 notes gap: Brightest Jewel

new.s: What was the earlier number of the present NH-65 (Pune-Machilipatnam)?
new.x: NH-65 was old NH-9, which ran from Pune to Vijayawada via Sholapur and Hyderabad.
new.angle: U0684 notes gap: NH-65 = old NH-9

new.s: The old NH-9 (Pune-Vijayawada via Sholapur and Hyderabad) is now part of which National Highway?
new.x: After renumbering, old NH-9 became part of NH-65, Pune-Machilipatnam.
new.angle: U0684 notes gap: old NH-9 -> NH-65

new.s: What share of Andhra Pradesh's railway network is electrified?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh's rail network is 100% electrified; 99.6% is the all-India broad-gauge figure.
new.angle: U0684 notes gap: AP rail 100% electrified

new.s: Through which four districts does the 308-km Nadikudi-Srikalahasti railway line pass?
o: Kurnool, YSR Kadapa, Anantapur and Chittoor
new.x: The line serves four backward districts, Guntur, Prakasam, Nellore and Chittoor, and carries cement and granite.
new.angle: U0684 N1 notes gap: Nadikudi-Srikalahasti districts

new.s: How much cargo did Visakhapatnam Port handle in its record year 2025-26?
new.x: Visakhapatnam Port handled a record 91.17 MMT in 2025-26, up 10.34%; 141.60 MTPA is its capacity.
new.angle: U0684 notes gap: Visakhapatnam port 2025-26 cargo

new.s: Which company is developing the Mulapeta greenfield port?
new.x: Mulapeta (formerly Bhavanapadu) in Srikakulam is being built by Vishwa Samudra; MEIL is building Machilipatnam.
new.angle: U0684 notes gap: Mulapeta developer

new.s: Where is the Nexus Integrated Logistics Park of Andhra Pradesh being developed?
new.x: The Nexus Integrated Logistics Park is at Chinna Eetivakam, Satyavedu, in Tirupati district, through the AP Maritime Board.
new.angle: U0684 notes gap: Nexus logistics park location

new.s: Under the One District One Product (ODOP) list, Narsapur crochet laces represent which district?
new.x: In the ODOP list, West Godavari's products are Narsapur crochet laces and processed prawn and shrimp.
new.angle: U0680 #7 ODOP products of AP (web)

new.s:
Match the following ODOP products with their districts:
List-I (Product) - List-II (District)
A. Uppada Jamdani sarees - 1. Srikakulam
B. Machilipatnam Kalamkari - 2. Kakinada
C. Budithi bell and brass craft - 3. SPSR Nellore
D. Udayagiri wooden cutlery - 4. Krishna
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
new.x: Uppada Jamdani is Kakinada's ODOP, Machilipatnam Kalamkari is Krishna's, Budithi bell metal is Srikakulam's and Udayagiri wooden cutlery is SPSR Nellore's.
new.angle: U0680 #7 ODOP products of AP (web)
